purpose: Promote Powy/TheF Charging from station-level active to treated using current first-party Italy direct-channel class-wide tariffs.

inventory.source: Italy canonical inventory / PUN scope previously tracked on research/italy-cpo-priority-20260905

treated.tariffChannel: direct Powy only: Powy Charge app / Direct Payment QR / POS; roaming eMSP explicitly excluded

tariffs.note: No DC+ penalty value shown in the current Italy tariff table; do not infer one.

treated.eligibility: Direct Powy channels only; app promotions may produce lower station-selected prices, so the published class grid is the deterministic standard direct tariff and promotional overrides must be treated only when explicitly mapped.
proofPositive: Current Powy first-party cost page explicitly labels its displayed prices as updated and exclusively applicable to Powy Charge app, Direct Payment QR and POS.
Italy table defines exact exhaustive power bands: AC <=22 kW, DC 23-60 kW, DC+ 61-149 kW, HPC >=150 kW.
Powy first-party app page explicitly separates direct Powy tariffs from roaming eMSP tariffs and states roaming prices may differ.
negativePaths: Generic Powy editorial articles with average market prices are not used as tariff evidence.
Third-party roaming prices are not promoted to direct CPO tariffs.

Station-by-station mapping is no longer required for the standard direct tariff because the first-party grid covers the full power domain deterministically; only explicit promotions are station-selected exceptions.
history: Run130 kept PWY active/station-level because the generic public guidance then inspected did not establish an exact deterministic tariff.
Run132 located the dedicated first-party Powy Costi di ricarica page, which publishes the complete current Italy direct-channel grid and exact power thresholds; PWY promoted to treated/class-wide.
